name: Neuropsychological Stability (Prognoz-2)
description: Developed by V. Yu. Rybnikov. Measures neuropsychological stability, identifies individual signs of personality disorders and estimates the likelihood of a breakdown under stress. A qualitative look at the answers can clarify biographical details and how a person behaves and functions in different situations.
instruction: Please answer 86 questions about certain features of your personality. Be frank, don't think too long about each question, and give the natural answer that first comes to mind. Remember there are no "good" or "bad" answers. Choose "Yes" or "No" for every statement and don't skip any.

1.text: I have given up on something I started because I was afraid I couldn't cope.

3.text: I avoid correcting people who make unfounded claims.

4.text: People show me as much sympathy and warmth as I deserve.

5.text: Sometimes I am sure that other people know what I'm thinking.

6.text: There have been times when I didn't keep my promises.

7.text: At times I am completely convinced that I'm worthless.

8.text: I have never been in trouble with the law.

9.text: I often remember numbers that mean nothing to me (for example, car registration numbers).

10.text: Sometimes I don't tell the truth.

11.text: I am more impressionable than most people.

12.text: I like having important people among my acquaintances; it seems to give me more weight in my own eyes.

13.text: Fate is definitely not on my side.

15.text: I have talked about things I don't understand.

16.text: I lose patience with people easily.

17.text: I have no enemies who really want to harm me.

18.text: Sometimes my hearing becomes so sharp that it bothers me.

19.text: I sometimes put off until tomorrow what I could do today.

20.text: If people weren't against me, I would have achieved much more in life.

21.text: When I play a game, I prefer to win.

22.text: I often cross the street to avoid meeting someone I don't want to see

23.text: Most of the time I feel as if I've done something wrong or even bad

24.text: If someone says something stupid or otherwise shows their ignorance, I try to explain their mistake to them

25.text: Sometimes I feel that so many difficulties have piled up that it's simply impossible to overcome them

26.text: My table manners are better when I'm a guest than at home

27.text: There are very nervous people in my family

28.text: If someone is to blame for my failures, I won't let them get away with it

29.text: I must admit that at times I worry about trifles

30.text: When I'm asked to start a discussion or give my opinion on something I know well, I do it without shyness

32.text: Over the course of my life my attitude to my profession has changed several times

33.text: When discussing some issues, I have agreed with others without really thinking

34.text: I have often worked under people who managed things so that they got credit for all the successes and others got the blame for mistakes

35.text: I walk into a room where others have already gathered and are talking without any fear.

36.text: I feel that I in particular am treated unfairly especially often

37.text: When I'm somewhere high up, I feel an urge to jump

38.text: There are people I know whom I don't like

39.text: My plans have often seemed so hard to carry out that I had to give them up

40.text: I am often absent-minded and forgetful

41.text: I rarely have bouts of bad mood

42.text: I would prefer to work with women

44.text: Sometimes when I don't feel well, I get irritable

45.text: I often have dreams that are better not told to anyone

46.text: My beliefs and views are unshakeable

47.text: I am nervous and easily excited

48.text: It irritates me a lot when I forget where I've put things

50.text: I like work that requires close attention

51.text: Sometimes I get so agitated that I can't sit still

52.text: An indecent or even obscene joke sometimes makes me laugh

53.text: Sometimes such bad thoughts come into my head that it's better not to tell anyone about them

54.text: Sometimes I take valerian or other sedatives

56.text: It's hard for me now to hope that I'll achieve anything in life

57.text: Sometimes I feel close to a nervous breakdown

58.text: I haven't always replied to letters straight after reading them

59.text: Once a week or more often I get excited and agitated

60.text: I find it very hard to adapt to new living, working or study conditions. Moving to new conditions seems unbearably hard

61.text: I have sometimes been late for work or an appointment

63.text: I have led an unhealthy lifestyle

64.text: I drink alcohol in moderation (or not at all)

65.text: I often sink into sad thoughts

66.text: Compared with other families, there is very little love and warmth in mine

67.text: I often have ups and downs in mood

68.text: When I'm among people, I hear very strange things

69.text: I think I was very often punished undeservedly

70.text: I'm afraid to look down from a great height

71.text: There have been times when I couldn't do anything for days or even weeks because I couldn't make myself get down to work

72.text: I drink an unusually large amount of water every day

73.text: There have been times when I did something and afterwards didn't know what I had done.

74.text: When I try to do something, I often notice my hands are shaking

76.text: I have periods of such strong anxiety that I can't even sit still

77.text: At times it seems to me that my mind is working more slowly

78.text: I feel that I sense everything more keenly than others

79.text: Sometimes, for no reason at all, I suddenly have a period of unusual cheerfulness

80.text: Some things upset me so much that it's hard even to talk about them.

81.text: Sometimes my nerves let me down.

82.text: I often feel as if everything around me is unreal

83.text: When I hear about a close acquaintance's success, I start to feel like a failure

84.text: Bad, often even terrible words come into my head and I can't get rid of them

85.text: Sometimes I try to keep away from a particular person so as not to do or say something I'll regret

86.text: Often, even when things are going well for me, I feel that nothing matters

summaries.Низкий уровень нервно-психической устойч: Low neuropsychological stability. A breakdown under stress is highly likely. Consultation with a neurologist or psychiatrist is needed
summaries.Нервно-психически устойчив. Однако сущес: Neuropsychologically stable. However, a breakdown is possible in tense or extreme situations
summaries.Высокий уровень нервно-психической устой: High neuropsychological stability. A breakdown is unlikely.
